# platform-orchestrator_metadata_key (Data Source)

Looks up an organization metadata key by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_metadata_key" "cost_center" {
  name = "cost-center"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The metadata key name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the metadata key was created.
- `description` (String) The human-readable description.
- `format` (String) The optional string format constraint.
- `pattern` (String) The optional regular-expression constraint.
- `schema_type` (String) The metadata value type.
